Introduction

MXM was a South Korean duo under Brand New Music, formed by Lim Young-min and Kim Dong-hyun after their participation in Produce 101 Season 2. Their name, MXM, stands for both "Mix and Match," referring to their harmony, and "More x More," symbolizing their ambition.

On July 27, 2017 they released the promotional single “Good Day”. They made their official debut on September 6 with the EP “Unmix”. MXM’s first full-length album “More Than Ever” was released in 2018, with the lead single “YA YA YA”. The two members went on to join the lineup for Brand New Music’s new boy group AB6IX in 2019.

Their final promotions as a duo was in 2019, as Lim Young-min departed due to his DUI controversy in 2020.
